title.zh: 授予萨马省Basey市镇电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act to Grant to the Municipality of Basey, Samar, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat, and Power System
title.orig: An Act to Grant to the Municipality of Basey, Samar, a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat, and Power System

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_196_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitutions, there is granted to the municipality of Basey, Samar, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power plant for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat, and/or power for sale within the limits of its territorial jurisdiction.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1947.
